description.zh: 用一组按比例递增的字号定义标题与正文层级，让排版有稳定节奏。以正文基准字号乘以固定比例（如 1.25 大三度、1.333 纯四度）逐级放大，标题之间形成可预期的视觉落差，不必逐档拍脑袋定 px；也可用 sm/md/lg 尺码或 clamp() 流式档位落地。
description.en: A ratio-based set of font sizes that assigns heading and body levels a stable rhythm. Multiply a base body size by a fixed ratio (1.25 major third, 1.333 perfect fourth) to step upward, producing predictable contrast between headings instead of hand-picked pixels. Ship it as sm/md/lg tokens or fluid clamp() steps.

use_when.zh: 页面存在标题、正文、辅助文字等多级文本层级
use_when.en: The page carries multiple text levels — headings, body, captions

use_when.zh: 多人协作需要统一字号，避免各自随手写 13px、15px
use_when.en: Teams need one shared size system instead of ad-hoc 13px and 15px

use_when.zh: 响应式排版希望字号随视口连续或按断点有节制地变化
use_when.en: Responsive type should scale fluidly or step at breakpoints with restraint

avoid_when.zh: 单一字号就够的极简控件条、图标工具栏
avoid_when.en: Icon toolbars and micro UI where one size is enough

avoid_when.zh: 像素级还原设计稿且不允许任何取整合并
avoid_when.en: Pixel-exact design reproduction that forbids any rounding

avoid_when.zh: 比例档位过多（超过 8 档），层级反而失去可辨识度
avoid_when.en: More than eight steps — the hierarchy stops being legible

note.en: The go-to for fluid type steps

note.zh: 基准字号乘固定比例逐级放大，档位离散、节奏稳定
note.en: Base size times a fixed ratio per step — discrete and rhythmic

note.zh: clamp(最小, 视口插值, 最大)，小屏大屏连续过渡
note.en: clamp(min, viewport interpolation, max) — continuous across viewports

note.zh: sm / md / lg / xl 语义命名，工程侧好引用
note.en: Semantic sm / md / lg / xl tokens — easy to reference in code

适用文本.zh: 标题与正文的全部层级

调节粒度.zh: 按比例档位跳变，一档一档调
调节粒度.en: Steps by ratio — one level at a time

notes.zh: 用 rem 定义 6～8 档字号变量（--text-xs 到 --text-3xl），比例写进注释；标题跳档而非连续堆砌，相邻档位差异不小于 1.15 倍才可感知。流式档位写成 clamp(0.95rem, 0.8rem + 0.6vw, 1.25rem)，两端封顶防止 4K 失控。中文正文基准 15～17px，英文 16px 起。字号变更必须同步检查行高与行长。
notes.en: Define six to eight rem size variables (--text-xs … --text-3xl) with the ratio noted in a comment. Jump levels rather than stacking near-equal sizes — adjacent steps need at least a 1.15× gap to read. Fluid steps look like clamp(0.95rem, 0.8rem + 0.6vw, 1.25rem) with both ends capped. CJK body starts at 15–17px, Latin at 16px. Any size change must re-check leading and measure.

basic.zh: 建立一套字号阶梯：按比例定义标题与正文的字号层级，并输出为可复用的 Design Token。
basic.en: Build a type scale — ratio-based heading and body sizes exposed as reusable design tokens.

design.zh: 字号阶梯设计规范：正文基准 16px，比例 1.25（大三度）或 1.333（纯四度）；共 6～8 档，命名 xs/sm/base/lg/xl/2xl/3xl；标题与正文共用同一阶梯，禁止页外写死 px；移动端用 clamp() 流式插值，两端封顶；每档同步给出对应行高建议。
design.en: Type scale spec: 16px body base, 1.25 (major third) or 1.333 (perfect fourth) ratio; six to eight steps named xs/sm/base/lg/xl/2xl/3xl; headings and body share one ladder — no hard-coded pixels outside it; fluid clamp() interpolation capped at both ends on mobile; pair every step with a leading suggestion.

implementation.zh: 用 CSS 自定义属性落地字号阶梯：:root { --text-base: 1rem; --text-lg: 1.25rem; --text-xl: 1.5625rem; }，标题用 var(--text-2xl) 引用；流式档位 --text-h1: clamp(2rem, 1.2rem + 2.5vw, 3.5rem)。Tailwind 侧映射到 @theme 的 --text-* 令牌。变更阶梯只改根变量，不改组件。
implementation.en: Ship the scale as CSS custom properties: :root { --text-base: 1rem; --text-lg: 1.25rem; --text-xl: 1.5625rem; } and reference var(--text-2xl) from headings; fluid steps like --text-h1: clamp(2rem, 1.2rem + 2.5vw, 3.5rem). Map them into Tailwind @theme --text-* tokens. Changing the ladder means editing root variables only, never components.

agent.zh:
在当前项目中实现字号阶梯。
先检查现有组件体系和 Design Token，优先复用当前组件。
要求：
- 用 CSS 变量定义 6～8 档字号，按 1.25 或 1.333 比例生成
- 标题与正文共用同一阶梯，组件内禁止写死 px
- 需要响应式时用 clamp() 流式档位，两端封顶
保持现有项目视觉风格。不要新增不必要依赖。
尊重 prefers-reduced-motion。
完成后运行项目现有检查，并列出修改的文件。
agent.en:
Implement a type scale in the current project.
Inspect the existing component system and design tokens first; reuse what is already there.
Requirements:
- Six to eight size variables generated from a 1.25 or 1.333 ratio
- Headings and body share one ladder; never hard-code pixels in components
- Use capped clamp() fluid steps where responsiveness is needed
Keep the project's existing visual style. Do not add unnecessary dependencies.
Respect prefers-reduced-motion.
Run existing project checks when done and list the modified files.
